# level3

Nothing of note with `ll` and `checksec`.

Functions found using `gdb > info functions`
|LIBC|user|
|-|-|
|printf|main|
|fgets|frame_dummy|
|fwrite|v|
|system||

This time we have access to the `system` function. So we will probably have to access it using a return address overwrite.
Unfortunately, now the `fget` function is used. Unlike it's brother, it cannot be exploited in a classical buffer overflow attack.

```python
(cat <(python -c "print 'a' *100" + '\n') -) | ./level3
```

